title: Query strings on item routes (/books/{id}?...) are not stripped, yielding 404
evidence: books.erl:76 route(Method,[Path],...) requires a single-element split on '?'; GET /books/5?foo=bar splits to two elements and falls through to not_found/0 at books.erl:85
suggestion: Split the target on '?' before dispatching all routes, not only the /books collection route

title: SQL built by string concatenation, mitigated by hex-encoding
evidence: books.erl:117 sql_text/1 emits CAST(X'<hex>' AS TEXT) for every text value and valid_id/1 (books.erl:94) restricts ids to digits, so user input never reaches SQL unescaped
suggestion: Approach is safe as written; prefer parameterized queries / a native SQLite driver if the project moves off the sqlite3 CLI

title: HTTP server handles one request per connection (Connection: close)
evidence: books.erl:38 always sends Connection: close and serve/2 closes the socket after one response
suggestion: Acceptable for the task scope; no keep-alive needed for the spec
